item.description:
### Security - **Signing in:** if Zscaler's sign-in answers with a redirect, it's no longer followed, so your API client's secret is only ever sent to your tenant's ZIdentity. The sign-in fails and says where it was sent. - **Calls to Zscaler:** redirects are no longer followed. A call answered with one fails and says where it was sent, so your sign-in token and a change's contents stay with Zscaler's API, and a change is never sent again as a read and taken as made. A change answered with a redirect says it may have been made: check the tenant. - **CSV files:** Bulk Test results, the Change Log and ZPA application lists now quote every cell, as the other CSV files do, and every CSV file the app saves guards a semicolon or line break inside a cell that's followed by a formula character, so a spreadsheet that splits cells on semicolons or lines can't turn part of one into a formula. - **Policy Simulator:** URL and ZPA application entries with wildcards are matched in a way that can't stall on an entry with many `*`s. A snapshot's Microsoft 365 list is now checked as the download is: entries the download would leave out are left out, and a list with more than 5,000 ranges or hostnames isn't used.
### Fixed - **Policy Simulator, Undo of a change:** when reading a list back to take the change's entries out returns something other than the list, the change now stays to undo again instead of being marked undone with its entries still there. - **AI Guard dry run:** an existing AI Guard proxy that ZIA lists without an ID is no longer offered for reuse; the dry run says it can't be reused, and the proxy reused is always the one it offers. - **Internet Access and Private Access Undo:** when reading an updated rule or application back returns something other than it, it now stays to undo again instead of being taken as renamed and left out. - **ZPA Undo:** the confirmation and Help now say that a rule switched off in the ZPA portal since the run is left as it is. - **Help:** "Couldn't reach …" now says which changes were never sent by how they're sent, so it's right for Client Connector's profile saves.
